note: Park on a strip between Hwy 168 and a broad Mississippi backwater channel 3 miles north of Hannibal; the east-side sites back onto the channel, several with their own small docks, and the park has three fishing lakes. The park changed hands in 2025 and now trades as Berry's Lakeview Campers Park. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 140 water/electric sites, showers, reservable by phone; no posted nightly rate and no booking engine. DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay): mostly seasonal in character with no nightly price (test 2). Renamed Berry's Lakeview Campers Park (new owners 2025). Riverfront plausible on the east-side sites.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay, test 2 + mostly seasonal): the operator's page posts no nightly rate and there is no booking engine (phone only); its tagline is 'Camp With Us for the 'Rest' of Your Life!' and it says only 'Overnight camping sites are available.' Imagery shows nearly every site occupied by a set-up unit with decks, sheds and private docks along the shore - a seasonal park in character. Google reviews (newest, read 2026-11-07): 2 months ago 'We enjoyed our summer here' (owner: 'see you next year'); 8 months ago owner 'cant wait for 2026 season'; 4 months ago 'we tried to book for two weeks. Calling, texting, and leaving messages got us nowhere' (owner: 'we just bought the place and have been doing major renovations ... phone line has been down'). I read it as mostly seasonal. Five tests: (1) price unknown - RV Life $$ (avg $33, 5 ratings) only; (2) FAILS - no nightly price posted, no engine; (3) no minimum stated; (4) occupancy can't be checked (no engine; imagery looks full of seasonal units); (5) not a home community. Reviews: Google 4.3 from 56 (over 4.0); RV Life 4 stars from 5.

NAME: Google lists it as "Berry's Lakeview Campers Park" (same address and phone); the owner replies on Google say they bought the park in 2025. The website (GoDaddy builder, (c) 2018) still says Bayview Campers Park. Stored name is the old one.
PRICE GATE: no posted rate; no gateway within 40 km (St. Louis 164 km); never stayed at.

WATERFRONT riverfront plausible, not changed: on Esri imagery the campground runs ~500 m along the west bank of a ~200 m-wide Mississippi backwater channel (levee farmland on the far side), and the east-side units sit on the bank with their own small docks - no road between them and the water. The three 'fishing lakes' are separate: a ~0.9 ha lake inside the park (a pond), and a larger ~8 ha lake to the north-west. The river-side rows earn the value; the lake rows don't add anything.
HOOKUPS: stored electric 30 (note prose) is not stated on the operator's page; left alone.
